name: 2026 TYR Futures Championships – Knoxville
location: Allan Jones Intercollegiate Aquatic Center, 2200 Andy Holt Ave, Knoxville, TN 37996

sessions.name: Day 1 Prelims – Wednesday

events._comment: Event 7: ALL heats of Women's 200m Medley Relay swim here in Prelims, after Event 6 (Men's 200m Butterfly).
Event 9: Women's 800m FR — Timed Finals. All but fastest heat swim here, slowest to fastest. Positive check-in required.
Event 8: ALL heats of Men's 200m Medley Relay swim here in Prelims, after Event 6 (Men's 200m Butterfly).
Event 10: Men's 1500m FR — Timed Finals. All but fastest heat swim here, alternating with women's 800. Positive check-in required.

sessions.notes: Positive check-in required for 800m and 1500m Freestyle (Events 9 and 10). Check-in deadline: 15 minutes after conclusion of technical meeting (Day 1 scratches by email/text to Admin Referee or Resolution Table). Events 7 and 8 (200m Medley Relay, ALL heats) swim in this session immediately after Event 6 (Men's 200m Butterfly). Events 9 (Women's 800m FR) and 10 (Men's 1500m FR) swim as timed finals in this session, slowest heats only — fastest heat of each advances to Finals. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 10:30 AM.

sessions.name: Day 1 Finals – Wednesday

events._comment: Event 9 fastest heat only — swims in Finals per distance event rule.
Event 10 fastest heat only — swims in Finals per distance event rule.
Event 11: ALL heats of Women's 200m Freestyle Relay swim in Finals after Event 10.
Event 12: ALL heats of Men's 200m Freestyle Relay swim in Finals after Event 10.

sessions.notes: Finals order: D, C, B, A. C/D Finals limited to top 18-Under swimmers not in A/B Finals. Events 11 and 12 (200m Freestyle Relay, ALL heats) swim in this session after Event 10 (Men's 1500m FR). Fastest heat of Women's 800m FR (Event 9) and Men's 1500m FR (Event 10) also swim in this session. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 6:30 PM.

sessions.name: Day 2 Prelims – Thursday

events._comment: Event 22: slowest heats of Men's 800m Freestyle Relay in Prelims; fastest 2 heats in Finals.
Event 21: slowest heats of Women's 800m Freestyle Relay in Prelims; fastest 2 heats in Finals.

sessions.notes: Scratches due 30 minutes after conclusion of previous evening's finals. Slowest heats of Events 21 (Women's 800m Freestyle Relay) and 22 (Men's 800m Freestyle Relay) swim in this session. Fastest 2 heats of each relay advance to Day 2 Finals. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 10:30 AM.

sessions.name: Day 2 Finals – Thursday

events._comment: Fastest 2 seeded heats of Women's 800m Freestyle Relay swim at end of Finals.
Fastest 2 seeded heats of Men's 800m Freestyle Relay swim at end of Finals.

sessions.notes: Finals order: D, C, B, A. C/D Finals limited to top 18-Under swimmers not in A/B Finals. Fastest 2 heats of Events 21 (Women's 800m Freestyle Relay) and 22 (Men's 800m Freestyle Relay) swim at the end of this session. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 6:30 PM.

sessions.name: Day 3 Prelims – Friday

events._comment: Event 31: slowest heats of Women's 400m Freestyle Relay in Prelims; fastest 2 heats in Finals.
Event 32: slowest heats of Men's 400m Freestyle Relay in Prelims; fastest 2 heats in Finals.

sessions.notes: Scratches due 30 minutes after conclusion of previous evening's finals. Slowest heats of Events 31 (Women's 400m Freestyle Relay) and 32 (Men's 400m Freestyle Relay) swim in this session. Fastest 2 heats of each relay advance to Day 3 Finals. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 10:30 AM.

sessions.name: Day 3 Finals – Friday

events._comment: Fastest 2 seeded heats of Women's 400m Freestyle Relay swim at end of Finals.
Fastest 2 seeded heats of Men's 400m Freestyle Relay swim at end of Finals.

sessions.notes: Finals order: D, C, B, A. C/D Finals limited to top 18-Under swimmers not in A/B Finals. Fastest 2 heats of Events 31 (Women's 400m Freestyle Relay) and 32 (Men's 400m Freestyle Relay) swim at the end of this session. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 6:30 PM.

sessions.name: Day 4 Prelims – Saturday

events._comment: Event 44 non-finals heats only: Men's 400m Medley Relay slowest heats swim after Event 40. Fastest 2 heats swim in Finals.
Event 42: Men's 800m FR — Timed Finals. All but fastest heat swim here alternating with Event 41 (Women's 1500m). Fastest heat advances to Finals.
Event 43 non-finals heats only: Women's 400m Medley Relay slowest heats swim after Event 40. Fastest 2 heats swim in Finals.
Event 41: Women's 1500m FR — Timed Finals. All but fastest heat swim here alternating with Event 42 (Men's 800m). Fastest heat advances to Finals.

sessions.notes: Scratches due 30 minutes after conclusion of previous evening's finals. Events 41 (Women's 1500m FR) and 42 (Men's 800m FR) swim as timed finals in this session — all but fastest heat, slowest to fastest alternating genders. Fastest heat of each advances to Finals. Non-finals heats of Events 43 (Women's 400m Medley Relay) and 44 (Men's 400m Medley Relay) swim in this session after Event 40 (Men's 50m Breaststroke). Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 10:30 AM.

sessions.name: Day 4 Finals – Saturday

events._comment: Event 41 fastest heat only — swims in Finals per distance event rule.
Event 42 fastest heat only — swims in Finals per distance event rule.
Fastest 2 seeded heats of Women's 400m Medley Relay swim at end of Finals.
Fastest 2 seeded heats of Men's 400m Medley Relay swim at end of Finals.

sessions.notes: Finals order: D, C, B, A. C/D Finals limited to top 18-Under swimmers not in A/B Finals. Fastest heat of Women's 1500m FR (Event 41) and Men's 800m FR (Event 42) swim in this session. Fastest 2 heats of Events 43 (Women's 400m Medley Relay) and 44 (Men's 400m Medley Relay) swim at end of session. Relay cards due to Admin Referee by 6:30 PM.
